name: Bronze-PMV Hybrid (Headline-Fresh AUA Supplement)
description: Resolve trade-settlement reporting latency between two Orion API endpoints feeding the Inflection portal: bronze `assets.csv` (CSV daily-AUM, fresher; captures same-day rebalance trades) vs silver `positions_mv` (REST per-client positions, reconciliation-stable; lags ~24h on same-day trades). Empirical 2026-05-14: bronze $203.34M vs pmv $203.18M = $156,715.66 gap (0.077% firm AUA), driven by 1 new HH + ~13 same-day-rebalance accounts. Andrew direct framing: 'headline/global AUA must show current state, get clever for the rest.' D-min implementation (~1h ship, ~50 LOC): new gold script `INF_D_00e.fresh_header_supplement.py` emits `platinum/firm/header_metrics_fresh.json` with `total_aua_fresh` field + `_meta.source_distribution_manifest`. FE prefers `total_aua_fresh` for header tile with fallback. D-max conditional follow-on (~1-2d ship, ~150-250 LOC at INF_B_00) gates on 1-2 weeks of D-min daily-delta observability data — earn-the-right discipline before broader reconciliation rollout. Sister project to ADHC_LEDGEH (origin-response L@E error envelope) + ADHC_FECACHE_COHERENCE (FE queryKey URL/chain decoupling): 3-project ADHC defense-in-depth corpus for cross-firm + cross-source + cross-cache data-freshness hardening.
